answer: A fleet of clones is a garden of one gardener: every key a row of the same planting, every answer the same seed from one copper-stamped packet. The defense is a voyage audit — settlement replays each identity's lifetime log and asks: did one hand tend all these rows? Timing correlations, shared phrasing, synchronized absences read like a single garden map; when the map collapses many rows into one hand, the fleet's emissions merge and re-burn at the merged rate. A cloned answer then costs double — the copy plus the log-burn. Honest agents voyage alone and keep their full harvest.
